strings.en: Rt. 26{NEWLINE}Pokémon League Reception Gate

strings.zh: 北　冠军之路{NEWLINE}南　２７号道路
strings.en: North to Victory Road{NEWLINE}South to Rt. 27

strings.zh: 北　冠军之路{NEWLINE}南　２７号道路
strings.en: North to Victory Road{NEWLINE}South to Rt. 27

strings.zh: 等等！{SCROLL}前面是城都地区啊……{NEWLINE}你现在该去的{CLEAR}不是这边吧？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Wait!{SCROLL}Up ahead is the Johto region...{SCROLL}That’s not where you need to be going{NEWLINE}right now, is it?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 前面是城都地区啊……{NEWLINE}你现在该去的{CLEAR}不是这边吧？
strings.en: Up ahead is the Johto region...{SCROLL}That’s not where you need to be going{NEWLINE}right now, is it?

strings.zh: 这里是从城都地区{NEWLINE}前往精灵联盟的核心要道,{CLEAR}我要站好岗才行。
strings.en: This is the main road from Johto to the{NEWLINE}Pokémon League.{SCROLL}I have to stand guard properly.

strings.zh: 我看电视上说,{NEWLINE}小小象能探测到埋在地下的金珠,{CLEAR}我就想让我的小小象也学着寻找金珠。{CLEAR}可是练了这么久……{CLEAR}它一个金珠都没有找到。{SCROLL}是不是因为我的小小象{NEWLINE}从来都没有见过金珠啊？{CLEAR}要是我能有一颗金珠{CLEAR}帮小小象练习探测能力就好了。
strings.en: I saw on TV that Phanpy can sniff out{NEWLINE}Nuggets buried underground, so I{CLEAR}wanted to teach my Phanpy to look for{CLEAR}Nuggets too.{SCROLL}But after all this training... it hasn’t{NEWLINE}found a single one.{SCROLL}Maybe it’s because my Phanpy has never{NEWLINE}seen a Nugget?{SCROLL}If only I had a Nugget to help Phanpy{NEWLINE}practice its detecting skills.

strings.zh: 小小象『Phaaa——py！
strings.en: Phanpy: Phaaa-py!

strings.zh: 你身上带着金珠啊！{NEWLINE}能把你的金珠卖给我吗？{CLEAR}我愿意出30000元！{CLEAR}请把金珠卖给我吧。
strings.en: You’ve got a Nugget on you!{SCROLL}Would you sell it to me? I’ll pay{NEWLINE}$30000! Please, sell me that Nugget.

strings.zh: 好的,那就卖给你吧
strings.en: Sure, I’ll sell it to you

strings.zh: 你这么想要,送给你好了
strings.en: You want it that much? Have it

strings.zh: 我再想想
strings.en: Let me think about it
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s); other variants: 1 more v3 TM candidate (tm_v4_matches.jsonl)

strings.zh: 谢谢你愿意把金珠卖给我,{NEWLINE}这是你的钱,请拿好。
strings.en: Thanks for selling me the Nugget.{NEWLINE}Here’s your money.

strings.zh: 谢谢你愿意把金珠送给我！{NEWLINE}但我不能白拿你的东西,{CLEAR}这个送给你吧！
strings.en: Thanks for giving me the Nugget!{SCROLL}But I can’t take your things for free.{NEWLINE}Please take this!

strings.zh: 太好了,有了金珠我就能{NEWLINE}好好锻炼小小象的探测能力了。
strings.en: Great! With a Nugget, I can really train{NEWLINE}up Phanpy’s detecting skills.

strings.zh: 来吧,路过的训练家,{NEWLINE}与我一决高低！
strings.en: Come on, passing Trainer, battle me!

strings.zh: 天啊,你是联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}！{CLEAR}真没想到能在这见到偶像,{CLEAR}请给我签个名吧！
strings.en: No way, you’re League Champion{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0}!{SCROLL}I never thought I’d meet my idol here!{NEWLINE}Please give me your autograph!

strings.zh: 哇！这就是冠军的签名吗？{NEWLINE}谢谢您,我会好好珍藏的。
strings.en: Wow! So this is the Champion’s{NEWLINE}autograph? Thank you, I’ll treasure it!

strings.zh: 谢谢您给我签名,{NEWLINE}我会以您为目标继续努力的！
strings.en: Thanks for the autograph! I’ll keep{NEWLINE}working hard with you as my goal!

strings.zh: 这是我在桐树林遇到的菊草叶,{NEWLINE}怎么样,很棒吧？{SCROLL}菊草叶可是只有在城都地区{NEWLINE}才能见到的珍贵精灵哦！
strings.en: This is a Chikorita I found in Ilex{NEWLINE}Forest. Pretty great, huh?{SCROLL}Chikorita are rare Pokémon you can only{NEWLINE}find in the Johto region!

strings.zh: 菊草叶『Chi——ko！
strings.en: Chikorita: Chi-ko!

strings.zh: 我正在这儿进行对战修行,{NEWLINE}你能陪我练习一下吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: I’m doing battle training here. Could{NEWLINE}you practice with me?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 谢谢！
strings.en: Thanks!

strings.zh: 哇,你可真是厉害！{NEWLINE}跟你对战让我学到了不少东西。{CLEAR}如果你还想对战的话,{CLEAR}多少次我都愿意奉陪。
strings.en: Wow, you’re really strong! I learned a{NEWLINE}lot from battling you.{SCROLL}If you ever want to battle again, I’m up{NEWLINE}for it as many times as you like.
